newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha firmer as buying interest emerges.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha firmer as buying interest emerges.

text.p: NWE naphtha was slightly firmer on Friday, although not quite as strong as talked swap levels would suggest, traders said.
May swaps were talked around $180.00/$181.00 and June paper was assessed some 50 cents to $1.0 above that.
Traders said buying interest emerged with a few players looking to purchase larger quantities of high paraffinic material.
A couple of players were reported to be bidding around the $179 mark for high paraffinic material, lower spec material was assessed around the mid to low $170s.
A Wall Street trader was reported to be amassing some 35,000 tonnes of material for a Caribbean destination, loading around May 10.
A 36,000 tonne cargo of Morroccan/Donges material was also reported to on the water.
A Swiss-based trader was said to be putting a Baltic cargo purchased some days ago into storage.
